title: UN says Yemen war displaces 112,000
gist: Podcast episode page: the UN says Yemen's renewed war has displaced 112,000 people; the Trump administration approved F-35 sales to Saudi Arabia; and an adviser to Erdogan said he will seek a third term.

insights.claim: The UN says the renewed Yemen war has displaced 112,000 people.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Rapid displacement signals the scale of the Houthi offensive and Red Sea instability.

insights.claim: The Trump administration approved the sale of F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Positive for Lockheed Martin's export backlog and a sign of deepening US-Saudi defense ties.
insights.locator: The Trump administration approved the sale

insights.claim: An adviser to Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said Erdogan will seek a third term.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Signals policy continuity risk for Turkish assets; factor into lira and governance assumptions.
